semester: 1st or 3rd semester, depending on the degree program

learning_outcomes.text: Construct basic geometric elements in various views and determine their true sizes as well as possible intersection points.
Transfer the volume form of a body into its surface form through unfolding.
Represent essential types of perspective and name their possible applications.
Draw, dimension, and tolerate components according to DIN and ISO standards in 2D views.
Name typical machine elements of general mechanical engineering, represent them according to standards, and describe their functionality.
Name and calculate fit systems and dimensional chains.
Apply basic functions in CAD for component design.
Describe and create components and assemblies in technical documentation using simple means and considering standardization in 2D views.

syllabus_topics: Design of basic geometric elements and volumes of a part in different views, determine true sizes and complete penetrations in drawings.
Represent the surface shape of a part as a flat projection as well as its main perspective types and be able to name possible applications.

Draw, dimension and tolerance components and typical machine elements in 2D views in accordance with the requirements of the Geometrical Product Specification and Verification (GPS) as defined by DIN and ISO standards.
Design parts using the basic functions of CAD-Software.
assessment_rules: To participate in the module final exam, students must pass the study performance (Studienleistung). The study performance is achieved by passing 3 out of 4 submitted assignments (written elaboration of 5-10 pages drawing designs). The final grade is based entirely on the module final exam. The module final exam requires students to represent basic geometric elements in various views and in perspective, create developments using true sizes, determine possible intersection points, and describe and create components and assemblies in technical documentation in 2D views according to standards.
